interactives.label: Rules of the run
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead come to you; the road behind stays quiet once you have cleared it. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The mourners' well
interactives.text: Mourners left a coin here for the walk back. The coins are gone. The walk back is still long.

interactives.label: The Reeve's grave-goods
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
